title: Hands creative production and interaction evaluations
purpose: Exercise actual specialist-to-Jev creation and delivery across distinct creative formats, then independently inspect the saved outputs. Briefs and plans alone never count as completed cases.

cases.deliverable: A distinctive, responsive, functional three-step Hands onboarding prototype with local task, correction and result interactions.
cases.acceptance: Actual Hands output; independent task/correction/result/back/reset/keyboard tests plus direct desktop/mobile visual inspection.

cases.deliverable: An original A3 science editorial poster and companion mobile explainer using verified primary sources and clearly labeled illustrative artwork.
cases.acceptance: Actual Hands output; independent source/numerical checks, complete printed-poster inspection, mobile layout and functional disclosure tests.

sharedPassRequirements: Creative content and source code are emitted by an allowed Hands specialist model and handed back to Jev for actual bounded save/validate/preview/deliver decisions.
The artifact exists on disk, loads locally and has no runtime errors or missing required assets; all advertised interactions work.
The visual composition has an intentional hierarchy, coherent typography, disciplined spacing and purposeful contrast; there are no clipping, overlap or filler scaffold defects.
The design responds to the particular subject and format, rather than repeating the previous personal website or generic landing-page cards.
Desktop and mobile outputs are directly inspected; keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic labels and reduced-motion behavior are checked where applicable.
Facts, provenance and prototype status are truthful. No invented live backend, user identity, measured capability, conference affiliation, customer or deployment is implied.
Repairs run through Hands. Independent reviewers may write reports and take screenshots, but may not directly repair the generated artifact and then count that as a Hands success.
Report final-attempt model/Jev timings, repairs and reused work separately from earlier attempts and overall wall time.
